name: Wave Fans
description: Fans of concentric rings in rows, each row overlapping the one above so only a scale of every fan shows, like waves on a calm sea.

code.style: --rule: ( z-index: @y; @y(1) { background-image: repeating-radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 0 0, var(--color2) 0 7.5%, var(--color1) 7.5% 12.5%), repeating-radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 100% 0, var(--color2) 0 7.5%, var(--color1) 7.5% 12.5%); background-size: 50% 100%; background-position: 0 0, 100% 0; background-repeat: no-repeat; } @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 50%; background-color: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); background-image: repeating-radial-gradient(circle closest-side, transparent 0 15%, var(--color1) 15% 25%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -50%; top: 50%; width: 200%; height: 100%; background-color: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); background-image: repeating-radial-gradient(circle closest-side, transparent 0 15%, var(--color1) 15% 25%), repeating-radial-gradient(circle closest-side, transparent 0 15%, var(--color1) 15% 25%); background-size: 50% 100%; background-position: 0 0, 100% 0; background-repeat: no-repeat; -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 98%, transparent 100%) 0 0 / 50% 100% no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 98%, transparent 100%) 100% 0 / 50% 100% no-repeat; mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 98%, transparent 100%) 0 0 / 50% 100% no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 98%, transparent 100%) 100% 0 / 50% 100% no-repeat; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
